demo and four on 30 seeds each, and five synthetic layouts (one chapter to twelve, six continents, a returning continent) on 8 seeds each, all build and walk clean
size is 96 plus 32 per continent: demo (2) 160, four (4) 224
mapSize.max caps the side (160)
a three cell border of ocean
no land of one continent within two cells of another (straits at least two cells wide)
each continent is one four way connected landmass, and four continents appear
continent radius follows its chapters' target minutes (Southmere, 195 minutes, is the largest)
every open land cell takes the climate table's biome for its temperature, moisture, and elevation (or carved lowland)
every open water cell is a swim tile
temperature bands split the land at the thresholds in world.settings (each near a fifth)
temperature falls with latitude (equator rows warmer than polar rows)
every wall (ridge, ring, lock side) is the mountain biome itself, impassable, never looked up through the table
coast is land within one or two steps of water
volcanic cells lie inside volcanic's own climate box, on inland ground
featureCoverage 0 places no volcanic ground
a larger mountainShare raises more peaks
a per continent radius override grows that continent
one region per chapter, each one connected piece of its continent

each pass is two adjacent mountain cells straddling the ridge between consecutive chapters, needing the later chapter's key
each landing and sea ring is one ring cell three steps from the sea; landings also need the ship
each lock is the cell in front of a boss door, needing the chapter key and its seal, walled on both sides
every twn_ and dgn_ of the graph is stamped once, in its own region
every stamp tile resolves through tiles.resolve
stamp doors read passable through tiles.flagsAt (town lintel 33, dungeon arch 33, cave stairs 1); stamp walls read 0
